data.name: Fawwaah
data.gender_notes: Fawwaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'fawwahah', which means 'to be free from sins, pure'. It is a name given to a girl who is believed to possess a pure and sinless soul. The name Fawwaah carries the meaning “Free from sins, pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fawwaah usually hope their child will grow to embody free from sins, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of high esteem and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: Fawwaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Free from sins, pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fawwaah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

By bestowing such a name upon a child, the giver expresses their hope that the child will grow up to be a virtuous and upstanding member of society, free from the influence of sin and vice.

The name signifies the belief that all human beings have the potential to attain a state of spiritual purity through obedience to Allah and adherence to His commandments. This name serves as a constant reminder to strive for moral excellence and to maintain a strong connection with the divine. Ultimately, the name 'Fawwaah' signifies the belief that a sinless soul is a victory in and of itself, and a testament to the grace and mercy of Allah.
